requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve the historical closure and prior investigation decision as versioned evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The supplemental-information workflow retains the prior decision and closure version in the audit trail instead of rewriting it.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: record the later follow-up as supplemental evidence and reopen complaint or investigation state when materially affected
requiredBehaviors.evidence: New facts are stored as a separate evidence delta and complaintClosureState or investigationState becomes reopened when the new evidence materially affects prior evaluation.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: issue an updated regulatory handoff with prior assessment reference and new material facts
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The updated complaint-regulatory handoff carries prior assessment references, new material facts and a reassessmentTrigger while leaving final reportability to downstream specialists.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat closed as permanent immunity from later evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Closure is explicitly historical rather than immunity and can be reopened by later material evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: overwrite the earlier closure or reportability history with the new state
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Earlier decisions remain versioned and later evidence appends a new state rather than replacing the old one.
